objective: Make the monitoring alert live region tell the truth when the health view is unavailable: a failed refresh announces that monitoring is unavailable instead of the 当前没有活动告警 all-clear, a genuine empty successful alert set still announces no active alerts, a recovery announces the recovered alert state once, and the visible alert panel never contradicts what assistive technology hears.
decision_supported: Whether an operator using a screen reader can tell a monitoring outage from a healthy robot with no active alerts, and whether the alert panel and the live region ever describe different states.
acceptance: an unavailable monitoring view announces monitoring unavailability, never no active alerts
a genuine empty successful alert set still announces 当前没有活动告警
a transition from unavailable back to healthy announces the recovered alert state exactly once
the unavailable announcement is not repeated on every poll because the live-region key is written before the visible panel is updated
the regression tests drive the real renderMonitoringAlerts with unavailable, empty-success, alert-present and recovery views and assert both the spoken text and the panel hidden state
the visible alert panel is no longer hidden while the live region reports a state, so the panel text and the announcement agree
the dashboard stays read-only: no button, write verb, health schema or API contract is added
evidence: pytest transcript for tests/unit/test_dashboard_accessibility.py with the passed count

the live-region output and the panel hidden state for an unavailable poll, a repeated unavailable poll, a genuine empty success and an alert-present view, captured by driving the real renderMonitoringAlerts under a DOM stub
the recovery output showing 监控已恢复。当前没有活动告警 announced once and not repeated by the following poll
the pre-fix run of the same tests showing the four announcement tests fail with 当前没有活动告警 on the unavailable view
node --check output for apps/dashboard/app.js, or the recorded absence of a node gate in Makefile and tools/scripts when none is wired up
the final line of build/verify.sh and the Task Packet validation exit code
stop_conditions: a backend health schema, alert-clear path, API contract or error-code change is required
the fix would remove the monitoring live region or suppress every failure announcement
the unavailable state could only be announced by leaving the last healthy message in place
a modification outside allowed_paths is required
the change would introduce a write or control path, a runtime dependency or a Node package
data_classification: public repository source, documentation and committed scripted fixtures; no secrets, personal data or physical measurement data
model_policy: AI may write the monitoring announcement helper, the alert renderer branch that consumes it and the regression tests; a named human Owner accepts the accessibility review of the announced text
risks_and_fallbacks: announcing unavailability could be mistaken for an empty alert set if the sentence is vague; fallback is that the text names the unreadable state explicitly and a test forbids the no-alert sentence on an unavailable view
showing the alert panel during an outage adds a visible element to the tab; fallback is that it reuses the existing .monitoring-empty styling, states the outage, and still renders no stale alert
the recovered prefix could be spoken on every poll; fallback is the announcement key, which changes only on a state transition and leaves an unchanged poll silent
rollback is a revert of this commit; the change is confined to the monitoring announcement path and adds no API or schema surface
